    # Step 1: Locate the search box in the complementary section and fill with 'reveals'
    search_box = page.get_by_role('complementary').get_by_role('searchbox', name='Search')
    await search_box.fill('reveals')
    
    # Step 2: Click the search button in the complementary section
    search_button = page.get_by_role('complementary').get_by_role('button', name='Search')
    await search_button.click()
    
    # Wait for the search results page to load
    await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')
    
    # Step 3: Click on the third result

    all_links = page.get_by_role('link')
    link_count = await all_links.count()
    if link_count >= 3:
        third_link = all_links.nth(2)  # Zero-indexed, so nth(2) is the third link
